title: An American Marriage
author: Tayari Jones
summary: Newlyweds Celestial and Roy are building a life in Atlanta when Roy is wrongly convicted and sentenced to twelve years. The story follows how the separation changes their marriage and the people around them.
readIf: you want a moving, character-driven novel about love, injustice and impossible choices.
skipIf: you prefer plot-led stories with clear heroes and a neat ending.
